whatsappMessage:
Hi Dr. Sanjeev Lall,

I noticed your medical clinic has an established presence near Gandhi Maidan in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for direct patient appointment booking and online consultations.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp appointment booking, consultation timings, aur patient care services integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/lall

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
"Hi Dr. Sanjeev Lall, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha."
"Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya?"
- **Branch A (If they checked it):**
  "Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp patient appointment booking, consultation hours, and your landmark location near Gandhi Maidan in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
- **Branch B (If they haven't checked yet):**
  "No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai, just wanted to share the idea and get your feedback."
"Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact practice details, actual clinic photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
